decision: Selected the swisstopo official building-address point EGAID 101787046 (Hofwisenstrasse 56, 8153 Rümlang; building EGID 210185249), the address NTT DATA publishes for Zurich 1, as the site locator. It lies inside cadastral parcel 5697 (EGRID CH457517770255), 28.6 m from the parcel boundary. It locates the building's address point, not the building outline or data halls.

consistency_checks.search_results: The SearchServer query for 'Hofwisenstrasse 56 8153 Rümlang' returns Hofwisenstrasse 56 (EGAID 101787046) first and Hofwisenstrasse 56.1 (EGAID 103471802, a 13 m² outbuilding on the same parcel) second.
consistency_checks.method: LV95 (EPSG:2056) coordinates from the federal address and building registers converted with pyproj to WGS84; parcel area and distances computed in LV95.

identity_bridge: NTT DATA's Zurich 1 page (version of 22 October 2026, captured 7 November 2026) and the Internet Archive copy of 13 February 2026 of its predecessor give 'Hofwisenstrasse 56, P.O.Box 11, 8153 Rümlang, Switzerland'.
The federal building-address register returns building EGID 210185249 at that address: non-residential, built 2010, four storeys, 7,426 m² footprint, 29,704 m² floor area, on parcel 5697.
